design.name: Rev E, polar speed x0.9 (study)
design.revision_note: STUDY, not a design: Rev E with every sailing speed multiplied by 0.9, to see how the odds change if the real boat is slower than the unvalidated VPP says (docs/Naval_Review.md). Rev E (13 Nov 2026): Rev D plus a bilge pump with the pump-and-sail leak response, sealed rudder servos (Blue Trail SER-2000 enclosures with magnetic-encoder servos), a potted magnetic-encoder tail servo with a magnetic detent, deadband steering, a fin-to-bulb weed fairing and a weed-shedding manoeuvre; vents, a humidity sensor and a pressure-decay test port. A new letter because it adds a system (the pump) and a sensor. Servo and weed factors are guesses (docs/Reliability_Review.md). From Rev D (12 Nov 2026): limp-home controller, potted electronics, RockBLOCK Plus in the hatch lid, main GPS to the stern post. From Rev C: C5: wing 0.80 x 0.375 m (same area), 11 Nov 2026; C4: acetal mast bearings; C3: structural review changes (YB3 to the foredeck, fibreglass post and counterweight arm, servo-savers, 30 x 22 spar), 11 Nov 2026; C2: hardwood keel fin; C1: electronics box above the flood level
